race.comment: ZE DEEL (12) produced an eyecatcher on debut last start over 1200m at Belmont, rattling home from near the tail to be beaten under two lengths. Carries the same weight after the claim and should relish an extra 200m. Clear top pick. HAMADRYAD (5) went to the front in a new role last start and picked up her first placing from 16 attempts, holding on well for second over this course and distance. In contention if she can repeat that effort. Lightly raced five-year-old AGENT REMINGTON (1) returned for a second campaign last start and was hard to miss, storming home for third at the end of 1100m at this track. Sure to be hard to hold out over this more suitable journey. SPIRITART (6) is fitter for two runs back from a 15-month lay-off and is worth including in exotics. TALKISSTILLCHEAP (13) has been kept safe in early markets and might be ready to run a big race on debut.
